scenarios.title: Valid login establishes an authenticated session

steps.expected: Username, Password and Login controls are visible

steps.action: Enter the runtime demo credentials and submit Login
steps.expected: Dashboard is visible and URL is /web/index.php/dashboard/index

scenarios.title: Invalid credentials do not establish a session

steps.action: Submit a deliberately nonexistent account with an invalid password
steps.expected: Invalid credentials message is visible and login URL is retained
Redirected to login; no dashboard is visible

scenarios.title: Login requires both username and password

steps.action: Submit Login with both fields empty
Clear username, fill only an invalid password and submit
steps.expected: Username has a Required message and login URL is retained

scenarios.title: Logout invalidates access to the authenticated session

steps.action: Log in with runtime demo credentials
Open the user menu and choose Logout

steps.expected: Redirected to login; no dashboard is visible

scenarios.title: Unauthenticated contexts cannot access the dashboard
preconditions: Fresh browser context with no cookies or stored authentication

steps.expected: Login form is visible and Dashboard heading is absent
